summary:
I wrote plan.md but built and rendered nothing. It lays out a pale marble Latin cross on the z=20 axis: two 11x11 west towers whose openwork spires taper from 9 to 1 wide up to crosses near y 92, the great gable and 9-wide lit rose window between them, then a nave, transepts and choir with steep slate roofs and copper ridges near y 41, and a lower Lady Chapel. Lit lancets, pinnacled buttresses and flying buttresses run down the sides, and a small copper spire sits at the crossing, so from the air it reads as St Patrick's.
Two flags: I faced the front west (low x), as the plot maps show, not east as the general text said. The cathedral roofs are hand-built because no roof preset fits, and the two residences are twin calcite houses with slate roofs and chimney stacks set against their walls. Pale marble Latin-cross cathedral with west front on -x: twin openwork octagonal spires, lit rose window, dark slate 45° roofs with copper ridge, flyers and pinnacles, lit stained-glass lancets. Residences are twin pale-marble Gothic houses with slate gables and chimneys. Six parts: shell, west front, roofs, spires/flyers, glazing/light, residences.

rooms.name: nave
rooms.purpose: Dark hollow vessel seen only through glass: hanging lanterns down centre, froglight glow behind lancets; no furniture beyond a few pews.
rooms.ways_in: Main portal x4..6 z18..22 y3..12 from west steps; transept portals at z0/z40 x50..54.

parts.name: marble shell
parts.scope: Plot 0 masses per SITE table: plinth y0..2, walls, piers, transept ends, choir, apse, chapels, Lady Chapel; openings as air; pierced_parapet, marble_wall, plinth, string_course.

parts.name: west front and towers
parts.scope: Towers x0..10 z3..13/27..37 to y44, buttresses, belfries (louvre_opening, bell), 3 portals (portal_arch), wimperg, gallery, great gable, rose window opening, steps slab_ramp.

parts.name: roofs
parts.scope: Nave/transept/choir gable roofs 45deg ridge y41/42 copper, apse hip, aisle lean-tos, ambulatory decks, Lady Chapel roof, crossing valleys; gable_roof_x/z, lean_to.

parts.name: spires pinnacles flyers
parts.scope: Octagon openwork spires y44..93 both towers (spire_ring, crocket, lucarne, spire_cross), tower pinnacles, buttress pinnacles, flying buttresses (flyer), fleche.

parts.name: glazing and light
parts.scope: Lancets with stained glass and froglight, rose_window, tracery_window, doors, lamp_post, lawns/trees, roof_light on every roof/deck, spire base floodlight.

parts.name: residences
parts.scope: Plots 1 and 2 complete: shells, quoins, dark-slate gable roofs with verges, chimney(), house_window lit, garden walls, doors, lanterns.

recruit.why: openwork octagon spires, crockets, pinnacles, flyers
stained lancets and rose window lit from within
dusk lighting of roofs, spires, lamps
